melia-1.description: Batch Melia 1 — multilingual transcription with automatic code-switching
melia-1.pricingNotes: Speechmatics Batch Melia 1 is billed at $0.129/hour with speaker diarization included. The reused timing estimate is provisional until Phase 6 benchmarking completes. Free allowance, model-training discounts, volume discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: Current Speechmatics docs publish a 1 GB limit for multipart uploads and explicitly suggest fetch-by-URL for larger files. They do not publish a current remote URL size cap or a batch-audio duration cap. Melia 1 requires language multi for automatic multilingual detection and code-switching; it does not accept language auto or translation.
